headline: Trump Floats $5,000 ‘Trump Dividend’ Checks if Republicans Win the Midterms
snapshot: In his convention speech, the president floated a $5,000 “Trump Dividend” for every adult American if Republicans keep control of Congress. The idea, like many others, may not come to pass.

Entertainment fallback language is blocked from normal public leads when verified stories exist
Topic deduplication prevents repeated stories from filling the same public page
